description: Source code for a Zephyr-based Bluetooth coexistence ticker module, managing GPIO-based radio coexistence signals and timing.

methods.name: time_slot_delay
methods.description: Schedules a secondary ticker after a delay to allow radio role to abort and release hardware.

methods.name: time_slot_callback_work
methods.description: Callback that checks the grant pin and either aborts radio or stops the ticker.

methods.name: time_slot_callback_abort
methods.description: Callback that aborts radio and schedules a work callback.

methods.name: coex_ticker_grant_start
methods.description: Starts the grant timing sequence for radio coexistence.

methods.name: coex_ticker_grant_irq_handler
methods.description: Handles GPIO interrupt for grant signal and initiates grant start.

methods.name: coex_ticker_init
methods.description: Initializes the coexistence ticker device, configures GPIO and callbacks.
